d:
Riot police have been deployed outside Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal as a political stand-off escalates between Prime Minister Donald Tusk’s government and President Karol Nawrocki, backed by the right-wing Law and Justice (PiS) party.
The crisis deepened after the tribunal’s president, Bogdan Święczkowski, was suspended, prompting protests in Warsaw and Nawrocki to cut short his trip to Senegal and return home.
